title: syzygium corneri
intro: Syzygium corneri, commonly known as the Himalayan olive or Himalayan Syzygium, is a medicinal plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever, cold, and cough. The therapeutic actions of Syzygium corneri include antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in Syzygium corneri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
